title: CollabFlow: Recursive Self-Improvement of Agent Collaboration
abstract: arXiv:2609.38662v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Recursive self-improvement (RSI) lets a system improve from its own outcomes; in LLM-based multi-agent systems, Agents refine one another within a task, and outcomes improve how they collaborate across tasks. However, existing multi-agent collaboration leaves this loop open: collaboration is pre-defined at the operator level, topology-only learning keeps verbatim exchange that propagates errors, and reward maximization on a system's own outcomes concentrates on a few teams. To address these challenges, we propose CollabFlow, an RSI system of Learned Agent Collaboration: a trainable Collab-Director constructs teams of complete Agents, a frozen executor runs them, and each round's outcomes retrain the director. Within each round, the edges of a collaboration graph carry protocols of Evidence-Conditioned Communication: a receiver adopts a differing answer only when the sender's evidence is stronger by a margin, so the director learns who

translated_title: CollabFlow：智能体协作的递归自我改进
translated_abstract: 递归自我改进（RSI）使系统能够从自身的成果中获得提升；在基于大语言模型的多智能体系统中，智能体在任务内部相互完善，而任务成果则改进它们跨任务的协作方式。然而，现有多智能体协作方法使这一循环处于断裂状态：协作在算子层面被预先定义，仅基于拓扑的学习保留了逐字交换从而导致错误传播，而基于系统自身成果的奖励最大化则过度集中于少数几个团队。为了应对这些挑战，我们提出了CollabFlow，一个学习型智能体协作的RSI系统：一个可训练的Collab-Director（协作导演）构建由完整智能体组成的团队，一个冻结的执行器负责运行这些团队，而每一轮的成果则用于重新训练该导演。在每一轮内部，协作图的边承载着证据条件化通信协议：只有当发送方的证据以一定优势强于接收方时，接收方才会采纳不同的答案，从而使导演学会谁……（摘要截断）
tldr: 提出CollabFlow，一个通过可训练的“协作导演”构建完整智能体团队、在协作图边上采用证据条件化通信协议以抑制错误传播、并利用每轮成果重新训练导演从而实现递归自我改进的多智能体协作系统。
en_tdlr: CollabFlow is a recursive self-improvement multi-agent collaboration system in which a trainable Collab-Director constructs teams of complete agents, Evidence-Conditioned Communication protocols on collaboration-graph edges prevent error propagation, and each round's outcomes retrain the director to continuously improve how agents collaborate.
